data.description:
Produce the zip the recruiter receives and prove it works from a fresh directory using only the README. Spec: docs/SPEC.md §12; Instructions.pdf ("send us a zip of your project, code plus a short README").

Why: the last mile. The zip must run on a machine that has only Docker, and the README must be sufficient on its own.

Scope:
- `make dist`: builds dist/brillio-listings-YYYYMMDD.zip from a clean tree excluding .git, node_modules, *.db, .lattice, dist, the two handout PDFs, and OS cruft. Prints the size and the file list summary.
- scripts/verify-dist.sh: extracts the zip into a fresh temporary directory, runs `docker compose up -d`, waits for health, runs the smoke checks from BC-13, runs `make check` (natively if Go and Node are present, otherwise inside the containers), tears down, and cleans up. Fails on any emoji codepoint in the extracted tree.
- Fix whatever the fresh-directory run surfaces (a missing file in the zip, a README step that assumes local state, a path that only worked in the original checkout).

Acceptance:
- `make dist` then `scripts/verify-dist.sh dist/<zip>` passes end to end.
- The README in the zip is sufficient: the verifier follows only its commands.
- Zip contains no .lattice, .git, node_modules, databases or PDFs.

Validation: the verify-dist output is the evidence; attach with --role validation along with the zip size.
data.title: Release packaging: make dist zip and fresh-directory verification

data.body: Plan-review triage (art_01M4WEMR2QYGFJGWXE9M1KYK3E, PASS-WITH-NITS): 9 findings, all obvious, all applied in the plan's Cycle 1 Resolutions block (mkdir -p dist; non-errexit reap of the background make up; whitespace-compacted body compares; 400 s bring-up deadline; dirty-tree check excludes .lattice; rebase->merge wording; lsof || true; Ctrl-C comment; TMPDIR trailing slash). No evolutionary findings. One complex question to the human: ship CLAUDE.md/agents.md in the zip or exclude them via a SPEC §12 edit. Implementation proceeds on the default (ship) because the answer changes only one pathspec list in scripts/dist.sh plus the §12 sentence, and no final evidence is recorded before BC-14 lands; the answer is folded in before review.

data.reason: Need: ship CLAUDE.md and agents.md in the recruiter zip, or exclude them (SPEC §12 edit)? Default ship; reviewer recommends exclude: they are Lattice/c11 agent instructions, agents.md duplicates CLAUDE.md, and they reference a .lattice/ the zip omits. Shipping discloses the AI-assisted workflow.

data.body: Operator ruling (human:Forrest, 05:40Z, relayed by orchestrator): ship both CLAUDE.md and agents.md in the recruiter zip as honest disclosure of the AI workflow. No SPEC §12 change.

Implementation at 1c80ba6 (9525970 feat + merge of master after BC-15 landed). Dry run on this tree: make dist -> brillio-listings-20261014.zip 326,997 bytes, 135 files; scripts/verify-dist.sh PASS (13 checks) in ~77 s, run with the three DOCKER/COMPOSE vars still exported; negative checks N1-N6 behave as planned. The fresh-directory run surfaced nothing to fix. make check green (golangci-lint 0 issues, go test -race 5 pkgs, vitest 396/396), shellcheck clean. Deviation from the ticket (recorded per plan): no in-container make check fallback; verify-dist exits 2 naming the missing tool when Go/Node/npm/golangci-lint are absent, because the Compose images have no make or golangci-lint and alpine has no C toolchain for -race. Other deviations: README check also greps 'Then open http://localhost:5173' and the four-listings claim; emoji self-test also requires '1' not to match. Holding before review until BC-14 and BC-16 land (press-ahead note 0).
